notes: The list, together with the queued Op. 82 pieces, already covers Moszkowski's original violin works: the Op. 16 Ballade and Bolero, the Op. 30 Concerto, the Op. 71 Suite for two violins, and the Op. 82 pieces. No missing items are listed. Arrangements such as the Serenata, Op. 15 No. 1 for violin were left out because I could not confidently name both the arranger and the edition.
